title: Selected Work
subtitle: Full-loop AI shipping — solo AI fundraising ecosystem, a Copilot skill live in production, vibe-coding onboarding co-defined with founders. Selected for the Taxfix AI First Builder role.

bio.short: I'm Tobias Treppmann, a product designer in Berlin who ships full-loop — brief, design, prototype, in code. Currently at Bibel TV running what the industry now calls an "AI-first builder" pattern inside a Head-of-Product-Design title: a Claude-powered fundraising ecosystem I built solo end-to-end, a customer-support Copilot skill live in production, agentic engineering as shipped design practice, and a design-system-as-API that syncs Android, iOS, web, and Figma from one source. Fifteen-plus years, and the last twelve months are the sharpest evidence I have of the exact working model this role names.
bio.long:
I'm Tobias Treppmann, a product designer based in Berlin. Fifteen-plus years across Bibel TV, ChurchDesk, Ninox, Datameer, and Hypoport — most of that time in Head or Director titles, and the last twelve months operating as the Builder pattern the industry is only now naming. Full-loop, model-adjacent, in code when code is faster.

At Bibel TV I built the AI fundraising ecosystem solo end-to-end: analysed past letters and their performance, encoded the seasonality and style patterns into a Claude Project with a multi-turn clarifying-question loop, built an internal web prototype the fundraising team uses to generate follow-up content, and shipped a Claude skill that produces that content across three customer-facing surfaces — in-app notifications, web banners, and video scripts. In parallel: a customer-support Copilot skill live in production against the CS handbook as context, with escalation as a first-class output and the human keeping every send decision; agentic engineering as design practice — Claude Code prototypes on real Bibel TV APIs whose component structures, API calls, and navigation patterns engineering copies and adapts into the production codebase; a DTCG-standard design-token API with three-tier hierarchy syncing Android (live), Figma (live via plugin), and iOS/web (endpoints ready). At Ninox I defined the vibe-coding split-screen onboarding model with the CEO and technical co-founder in founder-led stealth — prompt-to-database with direct-manipulation surface alongside chat, first-schema-is-wrong handled as the normal case. At ChurchDesk I dual-owned PM and Design on a funeral-booking system that cut coordination time by 70% and hit 90% acceptance under GDPR + Protestant/Catholic data-protection law.

What I bring to this role: full-loop shipping without handoffs; AI craft where the design decisions (what to load, what "good" looks like, where the human stays in charge) are more load-bearing than the model; agentic engineering that actually reaches production code paths; first-principles interaction design when the component library doesn't have the answer; and the honest posture the JD asks for — I know where my evidence is thick and where it isn't, and I can tell the difference.

context.company: Taxfix Group — consumer tax filing across Germany (largest market), Spain, and the UK. Three brands: Taxfix, Steuerbot, TaxScouts. Berlin HQ. Consequential-stakes product — getting a tax filing wrong has real regulatory and financial consequences for real people.
context.role: AI First Builder (Design) — IC 'Builder' role in a small pod (2–3 people), NOT design leadership. Full-loop ownership: brief → design → prototype → ship, few handoffs. Opinionated on AI craft, first-principles interaction design, and shipping in ambiguity. Base band 90K+ per Q1 answer 2026-08-09.
context.emphasis: Lead with builder posture and current-shipping AI craft, in that order. Foreground: (1) the Bibel TV AI cluster — solo AI fundraising ecosystem, customer-support Copilot skill in production, agentic engineering, design-system-as-API; (2) the Ninox vibe-coding split-screen invention as the anti-templating / first-principles proof; (3) the ChurchDesk 70%/90% funeral-booking bullet as the JD's explicit 'metric that moved when you did' ask. Berlin base, German native, English C2 — cultural-fit signals for a German-largest market. Trajectory framing: 'operating as an AI-First Builder inside a Head title' — not a step down; a step into the exact working model Taxfix names.
context.avoid: Do NOT frame as 'Head of Product Design with 15+ years leading design teams' — that reads as manager-track for this JD (see Q1 answer 2026-08-09 + personal-preferences-applied.md). Do NOT claim direct consumer-tax-filing experience — bridge via regulated financial services (Hypoport) + banking/insurance customer bases (Datameer) + regulated coordination (ChurchDesk), not fabrication. Do NOT claim the AI fundraising web prototype is customer-facing — it is internal to the fundraising team (Q4 answer 2026-08-09); the Claude skill outputs are what reach customers. Do NOT claim shipped/read-out A/B tests — Bibel TV framing is 'driver of the experimentation infrastructure, actively analysing conversion and usage data' (Q3 answer 2026-08-09). Do NOT claim 'shipped production code directly' — the truthful middle framing is 'engineering copies and adapts specific parts of the prototype code — components, API calls, navigation patterns — into the production codebase; parts land, edited by engineering, then ship' (Q2 answer 2026-08-09). Do NOT fabricate CS Copilot operational metrics (acceptance rate, override rate, CSAT, response-time reduction) — none verified. Do NOT drop 'Taxfix', 'Steuerbot', 'TaxScouts', 'AI First Builder' into the bio body — those are cover-letter cultural-fluency signals, not portfolio bio surface.

selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-fundraising: Featured #1 — THE single most direct match for the JD. 'Analysis → Claude Project with multi-turn clarifying loop → internal web prototype → Claude skill producing content across three customer-facing surfaces (in-app notifications, web banners, video scripts).' Built solo end-to-end at the prompt-and-context layer. Direct hit on JD's #1 must-have (personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster) + full-loop shipping + first-principles + AI-native craft. Foregrounded per Q4 answer 2026-08-09 truthful framing: internal web prototype + customer-facing Claude skill outputs, NOT 'customer-facing web prototype'. In-depth format so the pipeline architecture and design decisions (multi-turn clarification, three-surface cascade) get room. Screenshots + fundraising-performance-data confidentiality treatment still needed before published status.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Featured #2 — the shipped AI product in production. MS Copilot skill drafting CS responses from the CS handbook as context; escalation-as-first-class output (routes sensitive/acute-crisis messages out rather than drafting them); human keeps the send decision. Direct hit on JD's consequential-stakes bar (sensitive faith/grief correspondence — 'getting it wrong has real consequences') + AI-native craft + trust/edit/reject judgment. Foregrounded because it's the only case study where the design work reaches customer-facing outputs through a live, shipped skill. In-depth format for the design decisions (define-good-draft-before-tuning, handbook-as-context, escalation-as-first-class) — they compress badly at executive altitude. NOTE: describe as MS Copilot skill / customer-support Copilot skill / human-in-the-loop drafting; do NOT frame as 'custom agent', 'custom-trained model', 'conversational AI', 'chatbot', or 'agentic UX'.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Featured #3 — the JD's anti-templating stance in one case study. Vibe-coding split-screen direct-manipulation surface co-defined with Ninox's CEO and technical co-founder in founder-led stealth. Rejected the chat-only default from first principles (long outputs unmanageable; trial users won't write accurate spec); invented direct-manipulation surface alongside chat because the interaction demanded it. 'Show output, allow users to edit' user-agency principle. Direct hit on JD's 'first-principles interaction design' + 'hold your own with engineers and technical co-founders' + 'know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right'. In-depth format for the split-screen architecture and dual-path chat + direct-manipulation coexistence pattern.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Browseable #1 — the JD's #1 must-have ('used AI coding tools to build something real; not dependent on an engineer to implement your vision'). Web + Android prototypes built with Claude Code on real Bibel TV APIs and content. Per Q2 answer 2026-08-09 truthful middle framing: engineering copies and adapts specific parts of the prototype code (components, API calls, navigation patterns) into the production codebase; parts of the code land, edited by engineering, then ship. Iteration collapsed from days through spec-and-handoff to hours in working code. Actively evangelising the practice across the team. Browseable + executive because the two headline in-depth slots for AI craft go to the AI-product stories (fundraising + support-agent); this reinforces the 'builds in code when it's faster than Figma' signal without over-weighting Bibel TV in the featured tier. NOTE: do NOT resurrect the '~70% of AI-generated code ships' number from earlier applications — Q2 answer sharpens truthful framing to 'components, API calls, navigation patterns' + 'parts land, edited by engineering, then ship'.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Browseable #2 — the JD's implicit 'designer who reads the API spec' answered by 'designer who writes the API spec'. DTCG-standard token API + Git-based repo + Style Dictionary + automated sync across Android (live), Figma (live via plugin), iOS/web (endpoints ready). Three-tier hierarchy (global primitives → semantic → component). Architecture supports server-driven UI. One commit propagates to every platform automatically — consistency enforced by structure, not coordination. Direct hit on JD's design-engineering craft + system thinking + reads/writes API spec + cross-platform delivery discipline relevant to Taxfix's DE/ES/UK multi-brand operation. Executive format keeps the surface tight.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Browseable #3 — the ready-to-tell 'metric that moved when you did' bullet the JD explicitly asks for. 70% reduction in funeral coordination time (days → hours); 90% booking acceptance rate through smart filtering; 20+ cemeteries in Hessen region; dual PM + Design mandate; multi-stakeholder coordination from first principles (availability rules, buffer/lead-time, progressive disclosure). Direct hit on JD's 'point to the metric that moved when you did' + 'consequential-stakes product experience' (funeral coordination in emotional, time-critical contexts; GDPR + Protestant/Catholic data-protection law) + 'shipping in ambiguity' + 'full-loop ownership'. Executive format because the metrics + build-vs-buy narrative + regulated context are the load-bearing signals here; the detailed craft narrative sits in the case-study body for readers who go deeper. Only browseable case study with real screenshots already staged in the portfolio repo per HelloFresh's assets_note precedent.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Browseable #4 — the JD's 'sweat the final 10%' craft anchor. K-means color extraction + OKLCH color space + WCAG contrast validation, live in production. Kept the thresholds and tokens in design rather than delegating to a generic library. Direct hit on JD's 'craft: visual sensibility + taste + final-10% detail' + 'the craft that makes a product feel trustworthy'. Executive format keeps it complementary to the design-system-api anchor rather than competing. Promoted from Fin's hidden to Taxfix's browseable per this application's craft-first JD language.

Portfolio does NOT surface an evals story we don't have.

All AI product work is prompt engineering + skill design + context-provision + agentic engineering. This is honestly not a Taxfix requirement — the JD asks for AI-first *builder*, not AI-first researcher/scientist. Portfolio foregrounds the fundraising ecosystem as the closest 'model-adjacent, shipping solo end-to-end' proof. Cover letter does not need to address this.
